# Fountain Pen Ink Art

> A creative practice exploring fountain pen ink's artistic potential through techniques, education, and experimentation.

Nick Stewart's site documents his decade-long exploration of fountain pen inks for visual arts applications. The practice spans in-person workshops in Rochester, online courses, product development, and technical documentation of advanced ink techniques including chromatography and mixed media methods.

## Key Topics

- Fountain pen ink
- Ink art techniques
- Nick Stewart
- Chromatography
- Bleach techniques
- Diamine
- Ferris Wheel Press
- Ink swatch testing
- Visual arts
- Workshops
- Mixed media
- Shimmer inks
- Sheening inks
- Pigment inks
- Rochester studio

- [Homepage](https://nickstewart.ink): Homepage exploring fountain pen ink's creative potential in visual arts

- [Online Course](https://nickstewart.ink/online-course): Udemy online course teaching fountain pen ink art basics and techniques
